type_display_name: The display name of the type that will be used in UIs, e.g., marketplace, in title case.
type_name: A label that defines the generalised category of a relationship, based on shared characteristics or function.
last_modified_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the relation was modified the last time in the source.
created_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the relation was created in the source.
ingestion_time: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the relation was ingested into DKG.
type_id: The globally unique id of the relation type, generated by DKG using uuidv5.
id: The globally unique id of the relation generated by DKG using uuidv5.
last_modified_by: The identifier of the user in the source who modified the relation the last time. If missing, the value of last_modified_by of the asset (subject or object) is used.
created_by: The identifier of the user in the source who created the relation. If missing, the value of created_by of the asset (subject or object) is used.
